verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI insights or suggestions. GlitchTip offers a built-in MCP server so external AI assistants can query its error, performance, and log data, but the insights are generated by the user's own AI tools outside the product, which belongs to a separate MCP story. The detect_n_plus_one tool is an analysis capability exposed over MCP, not an AI-generated suggestion inside the GlitchTip UI.
